entities.summary: Liisi Ojamaa was an Estonian poet, translator, literary critic and editor. She was already known for her debut collection "Endless July", which was included in the collection "Poetry Cassette '90"; Elo Vee, Triin Soomets, Ats and Ruth Jyrjo also made their debut on the tape.
